frase_gancho.texto: A bronze Zapata who changed places twice and today looks toward the Government Palace.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You begin in the center of the city, in the Plaza de Armas General Emiliano Zapata Salazar. In front of you stands the Government Palace, and very close by is the Palace of Cortés, the fortress that Hernán Cortés ordered built in the sixteenth century. Since August of two thousand twenty-five, the plaza also has an equestrian monument to Emiliano Zapata, the peasant leader who made Morelos his territory. You begin with an introduction to the geography of the city. It is a good place to understand where you are before entering the museums.
